Class DoubleJointedArm

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.SmartPositionalMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.DoubleJointedArm
Direct Known Subclasses:
DoubleJointedArm, DoubleJointedArm
public class DoubleJointedArm extends SmartPositionalMechanism
A two-segment arm where each joint has its own independent motor controller.

Unlike a differential mechanism, the joints in a DoubleJointedArm are driven individually: the lower (shoulder) motor directly controls the first segment and the upper (elbow) motor directly controls the second segment. Kinematics are applied in software to convert between Cartesian end-effector positions and the required joint angles.

This mechanism is well-suited to FRC scoring subsystems that require both high reach and precise end-effector placement. A long lower segment provides reach, while the upper segment allows the end-effector to be folded back under frame perimeter when traveling or extended far over field elements when scoring.

Construction Example

// Each ArmConfig must specify the motor, gearing, arm length, hard limits,
// and starting angle before the DoubleJointedArm can be constructed.
ArmConfig lowerConfig = new ArmConfig(lowerSMC)
    .withLength(Inches.of(24))
    .withHardLimits(Degrees.of(0), Degrees.of(120))
    .withStartingPosition(Degrees.of(0))
    .withTelemetry("Shoulder", TelemetryVerbosity.HIGH);

ArmConfig upperConfig = new ArmConfig(upperSMC)
    .withLength(Inches.of(20))
    .withHardLimits(Degrees.of(0), Degrees.of(120))
    .withStartingPosition(Degrees.of(90))
    .withTelemetry("Elbow", TelemetryVerbosity.HIGH);

DoubleJointedArm arm = new DoubleJointedArm(lowerConfig, upperConfig);

This core class holds arm state, kinematics, and physics simulation only. Command and Trigger factories live on DoubleJointedArm, which extends this class and has control examples in its Javadoc.

    • DoubleJointedArm

      protected DoubleJointedArm(ArmConfig lowerConfig, SmartMotorController lowerSMC, ArmConfig upperConfig, SmartMotorController upperSMC)
      Constructor for the Arm mechanism.
      Parameters:
      lowerConfig - Lower ArmConfig to use.
      lowerSMC - SmartMotorController driving the lower joint.
      upperConfig - Upper ArmConfig to use.
      upperSMC - SmartMotorController driving the upper joint.
      Throws:
      DoubleJointedArmConfigurationException - if either SmartMotorControllerConfig has no starting position.
      DoubleJointedArmConfigurationException - if either ArmConfig has no length.
      DoubleJointedArmConfigurationException - if running in simulation and either ArmConfig is missing its lower or upper hard limit.
      Implementation Note:
      Protected so only DoubleJointedArm can construct this.
